update_mate_error.sentence: Updated SolidWorks: changed 1 variable in Gear_m1.25_N29, re-placed Carrier (the carrier), Sun, Planet (3 copies), HighDog, LowDog and RangeSlv in every mode; no interference between the gears in any mode, where they stand. It worked in H, the configuration that was active, then showed and checked N and L and left the assembly in H. Your UserFront and UserGap were in error in SolidWorks in the mode showing before this Update changed anything; after it, UserFront in N, L and H and UserGap in N, L and H are in error. SolidWorks may have shown its What's Wrong box for a few seconds during the Update; nothing in it needed answering. Save Gear_m1.25_N29 and RangeBox in SolidWorks to keep them.
